risks.risk: Salt water creeps into charging contacts and the case seam
risks.mitigation: Gold-plated pogo pads or wireless (Qi) charging, ultrasonic-welded seam, ePTFE vent — no open USB port

risks.risk: BLE does not propagate through water: no live sync while riding
risks.mitigation: Log to on-board flash, sync on shore; size flash for a 6 h session

risks.risk: Optical heart-rate (PPG) corrupted by motion and water film
risks.mitigation: IMU-based motion artefact rejection; sensor window flush with skin; validate against a chest strap

risks.risk: Strap snag in a kite crash (lines, bar)
risks.mitigation: Breakaway buckle or low-profile strap with no hook points

risks.risk: Cell swelling after hours in a hot car on the beach
risks.mitigation: IEC 62133-2 cell with protection IC; storage temperature warning; thermal pad away from the skin
Silicone (LSR) or FKM strap, UV-stabilised PC/PA housing

tests.name: Immersion 2 m for 1 h (IP68 as declared) + 5 ATM pressure
tests.method: Sealed units immersed in salt water, leak check by weight and inspection

tests.name: Salt mist 48-96 h
tests.method: 5% NaCl fog on contacts, buckle and fasteners; inspect corrosion

tests.name: Drop 1.5 m on concrete, 6 faces
tests.method: Free fall, functional check + seal re-test after the drop

tests.name: Thermal cycling -10 °C / +50 °C
tests.method: 10 cycles with the cell charged; check swelling and seal

tests.name: Skin sensitisation / cytotoxicity of the strap and window
tests.method: Accredited lab, materials in final colour

tests.name: Radio conformity (BLE)
tests.method: Accredited lab, FCC 15C + RED radio test suite

checks.formula: ΔT = P / (h A), all electrical power ends as heat, natural convection

checks.name: Interference between moving parts

value.label: measured
value.source_or_assumption: Boolean common of every part pair (OCCT), classified by the assembly joints; total 0.0 mm³

checks.threshold: 0 intersecting pairs > 0.01 mm³ between parts that move relative to each other (different rigid bodies, over their motion study) or across a parting line — CAD interference-check practice
checks.formula: V(A ∩ B) per pair of solids at the assembled pose and over each moving joint's motion study

checks.name: Overlaps inside rigid bodies (concept geometry)

value.label: measured
value.source_or_assumption: 0 pairs of rigidly joined parts interpenetrate (0 over 5 % of the smaller part)

checks.threshold: Parts of one rigid body should not interpenetrate: overlap > 5 % of the smaller part = concept geometry to pocket at detail design (warn); smaller overlaps are seats (info)
checks.formula: V(A ∩ B) for parts of the same rigid body that are not directly joined

checks.name: Minimum clearance of moving parts

value.label: measured
value.source_or_assumption: Lower bound: no moving part has a neighbour within 12 mm (or no moving joint)

checks.formula: min over poses of d(moving subtree, other parts); revolute props 12 poses / 360°, buttons pressed 0.5 mm

checks.name: Shell parting-line gap

value.label: measured
value.source_or_assumption: BRepExtrema distance between the two shells of each parting line

checks.threshold: Shells meet at the parting line: gap ≤ 0.3 mm (visible-gap limit for moulded enclosures)
checks.formula: d(top shell, bottom shell); an overlap is reported as an interference

checks.name: Fasteners by standard

value.label: estimate
value.source_or_assumption: Joint rules (screws per parting-line perimeter, motor mounts, spring bars); sizes from the part scale

checks.formula: Σ fasteners over the assembly joints
notes: 2 × spring_bar Ø1.5×27 (Spring bar Ø1.5 mm, 316L stainless (watch-strap type))

checks.name: Joint closure (build123d Joints)

value.label: measured
value.source_or_assumption: Each child re-placed from its joint frame with build123d RigidJoint / RevoluteJoint / LinearJoint.connect_to; 5 joints

checks.threshold: build123d joints re-place every part at its modelled pose: residual < 0.01 mm
checks.formula: |bbox centre after connect_to − modelled bbox centre|

checks.name: Every part is attached

value.label: measured
value.source_or_assumption: Parts with no contact (≤ 0.05 mm, BRepExtrema) with the part they are joined to

checks.threshold: Every part touches the part it is joined to (contact ≤ 0.05 mm)
checks.formula: d(child, parent) ≤ 0.05 mm for every joint
notes: Strap floats 1.42 mm from Bottom shell

build_strategy.title: Module assembly
build_strategy.explanation: You design the product around bought-in, pre-certified modules (e.g. motor + driver, battery pack, radio module, heater + fan): your work is the architecture, the enclosure, the integration and the software; the factory assembles the modules into your parts. Faster and cheaper than designing every sub-system, and the modules' certifications carry part of the compliance.
